- Tested interactions: grant a species-style gift naming claws and one gained in play, read the real sheet payload as the owner and as a stranger, rendered the real Physical section from those payloads; tried to remove, drop, give, steal and trade-stage the claws (telnet and web dispatch), undress; declared a Strike with the claws by telnet and web dispatch and resolved the round with forced Success rolls, capturing what the striker and a watching room are told; read back /api/combat/ and /api/checks/consequence-outcomes/; struck on bare hands and with a sword for comparison; repeated for a fist fighter with Weighted wraps (strike, then telnet remove succeeds); opened the real gift change page and tried a non-Unarmed template in the field; opened the Required content panel with a good and a deliberately bad natural weapon template; clicked Strike in the real CombatTurnPanel to see the weapon chips
- Fixture/live boundary: live code paths (grant_gift_to_character, equip, the refusal gates, the sheet serializer, dispatch, resolve_round, the DRF endpoints, the Django admin, the real React components); fixtures and forced parts are the factory-built characters, bandit, items and gifts, the Success and Success roll outcomes, the demo's example names Talons, Blood of the Hunt and Weighted wraps renamed onto the journey fixture (so the item description reads "A Khati Claws." in the stranger's Wearing line), template facet capacity set to 3 with two Keenness and Sharpness facets and a Slashing damage type for the species case, a thread giving +2 Strike base damage in the combat rounds only, the browser panels fed the recorded payloads through Playwright route interception rather than a running game server (the sheet render shows only the Physical section of the page, with an empty Physique because the fixture sheet has no appearance), admin pages as saved HTML with the admin CSS inlined from disk and scripts stripped, and the Required content fragment shown in the admin base CSS plus the ops panel CSS, not inside the htmx ops dashboard
- Overall outcome: PASS

## Comparison notes

- Sheet card: the demo draws the card on the sheet with a style rail and a profile under it. The build draws the same four parts (name, Unarmed tag, gift gloss, one mechanics line) in the Physical section's own Entry style, after the Physique and Distinctive features blocks, in the sheet's serif and ink tokens rather than the demo's. Its mechanics line states the real numbers (damage and type, the facets by name with used of capacity) where the demo wrote example prose ("base damage as a one-handed blade", "runes of keenness, 2 of 3"); the facet names are not prefixed "runes" because facets are not all runes. Fixture note: the Physique block above it is empty only because the fixture sheet has no appearance rows.
- Owner-only: the card is fed by natural_weapons, empty for a stranger, who reads the same item under Wearing; an owner's Wearing list leaves it out so it is not listed twice.
- Strike pick: the demo's With row is a serif-set mock; the build draws the same chips in the app's own tokens, as slices 1 to 3 already shipped. Claws sit first, bare hands last, in both themes and at 390px with no overflow.
- Roll card: the build's "strike skill for unarmed" and "stat for unarmed" wording is the slice 1 pattern; the demo's "for talons" and "The Red Hunt hits with Strength" are example copy and a style line (slices 2 and 5).
- Damage: with no thread bonus claws dealt 5, above bare hands 2, the same order as the demo's "bare hands hit for the least of anything". The Keenness thread's +2 is the "Strike: base damage" modifier, which slice 1 applies to every landed Strike by design, so a bare-hands Strike by the same clawed character also got +2 in that run; not specific to this slice.
- Third-person line: now article-free, "Hobb strikes Bandit with Talons.", which closes the advisory from the earlier review at cf5e1952f ("with a Talons").
- Gift admin: the demo label is "Natural weapon" with the help "Every character with this gift has this weapon, always equipped." and a lookup icon; the build shows "Natural weapon template" in the gift's field list after Technique skill, a plain select (Unarmed templates only) with the add, change, delete and view icons, and a longer help line saying the weapon is made and equipped once when the gift is gained and comes off only if the gift is lost. I did not exercise losing the gift.
- Required content: not in the demo; the row text comes from the spec scope and the bad-template state lists each fault by name.
- Not reviewed: the Wardrobe page's unequip button for a natural weapon (the refusal arrives through the websocket dispatch recorded above; the page itself was not rendered); the full CharacterSheetPage chrome around the Physical section (plate, section row with its three own-only tabs), which was not changed by this branch.

## Demo elements this slice does not build

- Style and Tradition rail and the Attacks, Defends and Vows profile on both demo cards: slices 2 and 5 of #4844.
- Style lines inside the roll breakdown (The Red Hunt, Stillwater Hand): slice 2 (merged), shown only for a character with a style, which these fixtures lack.
- "Crafted, worn on the hands" and the crafter's name for wraps on the sheet: item-system content that exists today; the fixture set no crafter and the wraps are not a natural weapon, so no sheet card is drawn for them.
